what: The Worst page: PS2 games that critics scored lowest, by release region. Made by hand from public pages on 2026-10-31; a partial list, not a ranking of every game. Scores come from different aggregators (Metacritic 0-100, GameRankings %), so the order within a list is only a rough guide. A game is listed under every region its Wikipedia page gives a PS2 release date for; Metacritic scores are not split by region, so a game released in both appears in both lists with the same score. No popular-vote ranking is included: none could be read. Add a game only with a source you read.
